lcc_original: 拉麥活到一百八十二歲，生了一個兒子：
notes: UNV and LCC texts are lexically identical for this verse; only terminal punctuation differs (LCC uses ： instead of ，). All SNs transferred in place with no realignment needed.
WH08141 (שָׁנָה, year) appears twice: once attached to 一百 (reflecting the Hebrew construct 'hundred year') and once to 歲 (the final year-count word), matching the UNV distribution exactly.
